t: Din shilshul perot beyom tob mimmaqom lemaqom
s: Din shilshul perot beyom tob mimmaqom lemaqom ubo d' seipim: mi sheyyesh lo chittim useorim o shear perot shetuchim al rosh gaggo lehityabbesh veraa geshamim memashmeshin ubaim — mippene hepsed mamono hittiru lo chakamim litroach beyom tob ulehashlik happerot derek arubba shebbaggag. Abal asur litroach ulehoridam beatzmo besullam o bemadrega, ella yeshalshelem bechebel derek arubba vehen nopelin laaretz, sheen kan tircha yetera. Veim en arubba begag zeh — lo yolikennu legag acher sheyyesh bo arubba, apillu hen semukin zeh lezeh vehen shavin sheen haechad gaboah mechabero. Veken im gag zeh sheen bo arubba hu muqqap bemaaqeh veyesh challon bemaaqeh zo — lo yeshalshelem bechebel derek zeh hachallon, mippene sheyyesh torach lehaalotam min haggag ad hachallon, vetorach zeh vekayyotze bo lo hittiru lo mippene hepsed mamono.

Keshehu meshalshel derek arubba shebbeoto haggag — muttar lo leshalshel apillu harbeh quppot bebat achat, vaapillu yesh baggag harbeh meod — muttar lo lepannot et hakkol shello yishshaer bo meuma, veen chosheshin shemma yekabbed et haggag veyashveh haggumot shebbo kemo shechosheshin beshabbat kemo shennitbaer besimman shl"z, mippene shebbeyom tob lo hechemiru kol kak.

Muttar lekassot perot o kadde yayin mippene haddelep, vaapillu lebenim shehem muqtzim muttar lekassotan mippene haddelep, mippene hepsed mamono hittiru lo litroach tircha muetet ap al pi sheen bah tzorek yom tob.
Litten keli tachat haddelep — kedino beshabbat kak dino beyom tob, kemo shennitbaer besimman shl"ch ayyen sham.
